key_insight: Solvent-exposed vitrimer networks begin losing connectivity below their critical dissolution temperature and form disconnected network fragments rather than fully separating into individual chains.
engineering_relevance: Understanding temperature- and crosslink-dependent fragmentation could guide solvent-assisted vitrimer recycling strategies.
method: Analysis of network fragmentation and intrachain dynamic bonds
evidence_signal: Simulations show that the critical dissolution temperature increases nonlinearly with crosslink concentration, while intrachain dynamic bonds increase with temperature.
watch_item: The abstract reports simulation results without experimental validation, so applicability to practical solvent–vitrimer systems remains to be established.
paper_title: Solvent-Mediated Disintegration of a Vitrimer Network
